review_description: Quoting honest and straightforward.  Swift good quality install, punctual, polite and tidy.  Great service, well documented and explained.  Excellent follow up and cross check that grid connection was carried out correctly.  Always happy to go the extra yard when explaining technical detail.

Solar Spot had previously installed solar panels and I included them in the request for quotes.Jason came by and explained what was recommended.Installation was efficient and conducted by courteous tradesmen. Punctual and efficient.

Installed 5KW system 5 years ago and has preformed better than expected,Haven't had a power bill since,always been in credit.Solar Spot have been fantastic in all my dealings even talked me through a small issue over the phone on a Saturday long weekend.Nothing is to much trouble.Highly recommend this company.
The website provided a convenient way to get quotes from quality installers. I have passed on the link to the website to a number of people.
